subject.title: fix(agents): compact tool search drops arguments and bypasses validation

question: Does the intended trusted-tool contract permit this shared post-hook schema validation for existing compact callers, including errors for previously forwarded malformed arguments?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the behavior of malformed trusted calls at a core/plugin execution boundary; source snippets support the direction, but accepting that compatibility contract requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept strict trusted-call validation
options.body: Merge after the exact-head Gateway proof and completed required checks show that actionable validation errors are the intended upgrade behavior.

options.title: Preserve legacy forwarding
options.body: Limit the repair to flattened-argument recovery and leave malformed trusted arguments to each tool’s existing handler.

options.title: Define an explicit compatibility mode
options.body: Keep legacy forwarding by default and make strict validation opt-in only if maintainers identify existing callers that depend on malformed inputs reaching tools.

recommendation.title: Accept strict trusted-call validation
recommendation.body: Merge after the exact-head Gateway proof and completed required checks show that actionable validation errors are the intended upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch author is the strongest available concrete owner signal for the proposed Tool Search contract change.
